title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: Hum Aapke Hain Kaun
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love through family celebrations, but after tragedy, duty and family expectations challenge their chance at happiness.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee fights Norwegian authorities to regain custody of her children, battling cultural bias and legal hurdles in a foreign land.

title: Mission Raniganj : The Great Bharat Rescue
desc: Jaswant Singh Gill, a mining engineer, bravely leads a rescue mission to save 65 miners stuck inside a flooded coal mine, risking everything for their lives and safety.

title: Gunjan Saxena: The Kargil Girl
desc: Ambitious Gunjan Saxena dreams of flying. Facing resistance, she becomes a pilot and proves her courage by serving the nation bravely during the Kargil War. A story of determination.

title: English Vinglish
desc: Shashi, a housewife and caterer, is mocked for not knowing English. Her journey to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and prove her worth as a mother and wife.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Gangster
desc: Simran moves to Seoul for a new life, but chaos returns when gangster Daya re-enters her world. Torn between him and Akash, a singer, she faces a heart-wrenching choice.

title: Iqbal
desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.

title: Vivah - Journey From Engagment To Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan, is engaged to Prem from a wealthy family. Just two days before the wedding, her house catches fire, leaving her with first-degree burns.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
desc: In a ravaged world, a brave group races to protect a woman carrying Lord Vishnu's final avatar, Kalki, from Yaskin-the ruthless god-king bent on destroying her destiny.

title: Chandu Champion
desc: An extraordinary man bravely faces relentless challenges. His resilience and spirit guide him through adversity, forging historic achievements and inspiring countless people worldwide.

title: Jawan
desc: A man fueled by a long-held promise sets out to fix the injustices around him, but his mission turns perilous when he confronts a fearless, ruthless outlaw responsible for immense suffering.

title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

title: Sniff
desc: Sunny Gill, born without smell, gains superpowers after a lab accident enhances his senses. He transforms into a superhero, discovering strength and purpose in his new identity.
